description.en: RDF version of the Apertium bilingual dictionary EO-CA. The original dataset (in LMF) comes from http://hdl.handle.net/10230/22861 . The RDF version of the lexica is modelled using lemon (http://lemon-model.net/) and the translation module (http://purl.org/net/translation). More about the Apertium RDF dictionaries at http://linguistic.linkeddata.es/apertium/

contact_point.name: Hèctor Alòs i Font ;  Universitat d'Alacant. Grup Transducens ; Universitat Pompeu Fabra. Institut Universitari de Lingüística Aplicada (IULA)

other_download.title: Zipped Dump
other_download.description: It contains two lexicons (EO, CA) and the Translation Set EO-CA, as well as the metadata file.

other_download.title: Esperanto lexicon URI
other_download.description: This online lexicon not only contains the EO lexical entries from the EO-CA bilingual dictionary (that can be found in the zipped dump) but also aggregates the lexical entries in EO coming from all the published Apertium RDF dictionaries.

other_download.title: Catalan lexicon URI
other_download.description: This online lexicon not only contains the CA lexical entries from the EO-CA bilingual dictionary (that can be found in the zipped dump) but also aggregates the lexical entries in CA coming from all the published Apertium RDF dictionaries.

other_download.title: Dataset description in DCAT
other_download.description: This extends the metadata in http://datahub.io/dataset/apertium-rdf-eo-ca.rdf with licence and provenance.
